v1.cam-slow-push-in.s05.v1c1.unit: scale factor of the whole network about the frame centre (f830 = 1.0; 0.98990 at the cut f788 -> 1.00897 at f868 = x1.0193)
v1.cam-slow-push-in.s05.v1c1.note: S05 push-in: least-squares uniform scale about the frame centre fitted to 23-26 sub-pixel cell tracks outside the headline band (residual 0.03-0.06 px). Already moving at the cut f788 and still moving at f868 (no rest at either end), constant rate 0.00024/f (linear); from f869 the T5 zoom-through takes over. Normalised by the end samples, so the fitted duration is the visible span, not a designed duration. Differs in easing from the S02 instance (ease-out).

v1.cam-slow-push-in.v1c1.unit: scale factor of the whole network about the frame centre (f260 = 1.0; rest 0.98385 -> 1.01810 = x1.0348)
v1.cam-slow-push-in.v1c1.note: S02 hold push-in, re-tracked: least-squares uniform scale about the frame centre fitted to 26-52 sub-pixel cell tracks (residual 0.03-0.08 px; independent warp-NCC track scratch/s2_pushin_warp.csv agrees within 0.00005). Rest through f225, first moved frame f226 at full speed (0.00048/f, no ease-in), decelerates to rest at about f333 (5 f into the T2 fade). Replaces the earlier fit on s2_hold_zoom_fine.csv, whose integer-size template steps and a fade artefact at f330 produced an overshooting bezier.

v1.counter-accelerating-count.v1c1.note: counter digits read off frame-numbered crops f114-f225; count 1 at f114 to 100 at f222, accelerating

v1.icon-idle-float.v1c1.unit: px (icon x 420 badge-template centre; 20.0 px = 1.85% of frame height peak to peak)
v1.icon-idle-float.v1c1.note: one half-swing (lowest point f26.4 -> highest point f104.8) of the S01 idle float of the agent icon at x 420; from/to are the extremes of the shared-period sine fit (y = rest + 9.98 cos(2 pi (f - 26.4)/156.9)), because the next extreme falls after the exit starts (f100). All 8 icons follow the same sine (period 156.9 f, amplitude 9.95-9.99 px, rms residual 0.03-0.04 px over f20-f99) with their own phase; sub-pixel template tracks scratch/s1_icon_float.csv.
